definition: The value of $y$ where a line crosses the $y$-axis; for $y = mx + c$ it is $c$, and the line meets the $y$-axis at the point $(0, c)$.
An equation that every point on a straight line fits, usually written $y = mx + c$, where $m$ is the gradient and $c$ is the $y$-intercept; a vertical line has the form $x = k$.
